title: AC1024 associative geometry-dependency source links
scope: For the two named AC1024 witnesses, join each non-null inline constrained-geometry reference to its ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY, owning constraint group/action list, dependent-on entity, owner route and persistent-reactor backlink. Audit the non-null readdep/node references without promoting their meaning beyond the source field labels and observed link consistency.

autodeskAssocDependency.meaning: Autodesk documents dependencies as owned by actions and attached to dependent objects as persistent reactors. The parser's dep_on reference is checked against the observed entity and its reactor backlink.

autodeskAssocGeomDependency.meaning: AcDbAssocGeomDependency represents a dependency on a subentity of geometric data. This supports checking that the source object reference resolves to a drawing entity; it does not establish application-level geometric meaning.

independentReader.name: LibreDWG dwgread
independentReader.sourceFields: /Users/dli/dev/libredwg/include/dwg.h: Dwg_Object_ASSOCDEPENDENCY dep_on, readdep, node; ASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY inherits the common dependency fields
independentReader.limitation: LibreDWG independently exposes the dependency objects, common references, action arrays, source entities and reactor arrays. It does not decode the inline associative constraint node bodies; the local adapter supplies those node-to-dependency references.

fieldInterpretation.m_dependencyHandle: The local bounded parser maps the first dependency reference to LibreDWG's dep_on. It resolves to the observed LINE, ARC or INSERT entity and has one matching persisted-reactor backlink in each audited source profile.
fieldInterpretation.m_readDependencyHandle: The source field readdep can point to a preceding ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY or, in the INSERT profile, to an LWPOLYLINE entity. The audit checks target type, same-group/action relation and reciprocal node link where the target is another dependency; it does not assign additional semantic meaning to readdep.
fieldInterpretation.m_writeDependencyHandle: The existing compatibility field stores LibreDWG's node reference. In the civil witness it points to the next dependency in the same-group chain or the observed INSERT. The audit checks reciprocal readdep/node links for dependency targets and owner/reactor resolution for entity targets; the public legacy field name is not reinterpreted.

implementation.behavior: The bounded AC1024 graph audit indexes typed entities by unique handle and containing block, verifies source owner routes using BLOCK_RECORD membership, and follows each non-null inline node geometry reference to one typed geometry dependency in the same group and action list. It resolves dep_on entity targets and validates owner context/reactor backlinks. Non-null readdep/node links must resolve either to reciprocal same-group geometry-dependency links in the action list or to typed entities with owner and reactor backlinks. The INSERT/LWPOLYLINE pair must share the INSERT's referenced BLOCK_RECORD owner route.
implementation.strictOutput: dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized remains enforced. No associative DXF object is written and no DXF output is created.

normalSourceRuns.result: Both source imports report geometry-dependency closure complete, then refuse export because associative graph serialization is not implemented. Neither output DXF exists.

asanSourceRuns.result: Each ASan source log is byte-identical to its normal counterpart; no sanitizer diagnostics; neither output DXF exists.

validation.automatedTestSuites: Not run; the decisive focused validation is the normal and ASan import of both source witnesses plus independent LibreDWG JSON projections.

limitations: Coverage is limited to the represented AC1024 inline-node profiles in these two physical witnesses; it is not family-wide or version-wide qualification.
The OARX references establish API roles, not DWG byte layout or DXF writer semantics.
Remaining dictionary, XRECORD, group, layout, picture-block, nested INSERT, attribute and compound-child recursive closure is open.
Associative source-to-emitted identity, DXF serialization, readback and consumer meaning are unqualified.
nextAction: Close remaining recursive references outside the audited geometry-dependency profiles, then implement complete reachable-graph serialization and independent readback while retaining strict refusal until every output gate passes.
